title: The Enhanced Hydrogen Storage Capacity of Carbon Fibers: The Effect of Hollow Porous Structure and Surface Modification
material_description: PCF_H 0.3 | porous carbon fiber: PAN/PVA_H bi-component fiber (PAN:PVA_H 7:3 by weight, 15 wt% solutions in DMSO) wet-spun into MeOH, PVA_H removed in distilled water at 100 C for 5 h, stabilized in air at 280 C for 1 h and carbonized under N2 at 1200 C for 1 h
source_location: main p. 7, Figure 4c, series PCF_H0.3 (green hexagons), filled marker at 0.099 MPa
notes: digitized filled marker from main p. 7, Figure 4c (PCF_H0.3 (green hexagons)); x read in MPa and converted to bar (x10): 0.0993 MPa; archive: fig4c_PCF_H0.3_filled.json. Figure 4c caption does not say which markers are adsorption or desorption (empty/filled is defined only for the N2 isotherms of Figure 4a); filled markers span 0-10 MPa and open markers appear mainly below about 1.3 MPa as a second branch; all coded adsorption because the paper does not state that any point was measured on desorption. Isotherm point count = markers counted (15 filled, no open marker visible; any origin point hidden behind CF markers). | Table 1 and Table 2: S_BET 889 m2/g, Vp 0.47 cm3/g, Vmicro 0.34 cm3/g (72.3% of Vp); W_average 1.12 nm (average micropore width, Saito-Foley; pore_diameter_method = other).
